title: Sound and Vibrations
seo_title: Grade 1 Sound and Vibrations Worksheets: What Makes Sound?
standard_text: Plan and conduct investigations to provide evidence that vibrating materials can make sound and that sound can make materials vibrate.
meta_desc: Free grade 1 science worksheets on sound and vibrations (NGSS 1-PS4-1): drums, bells and rubber bands, stopping sounds and seeing vibrations. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_sub: Things vibrate to make sound. Loud sound can shake things too.
body_html:
How to think about it

Sound comes from shaking.

  • Vibrate = shake fast.
  • Stop the shaking. The sound stops.
  • Loud sound can shake things.
Example

You hit a drum. What makes the sound?

The drum shakes.

Answer: the vibrating drum

Example

You hold a ringing bell. What happens?

It stops shaking.

Answer: The sound stops.

Common mistakes

  • Thinking still things make sound.
  • Thinking you cannot see vibrations. Rice on a drum shows them.
  • Thinking sound cannot move things.

Put rice on a drum and tap it, or put a ringing tuning fork in water.
Yes. A loud drum can make rice on another drum jump, and a loud truck can shake a window.
